templates.LIST_ALL_MAJORS: SELECT DISTINCT major_name, major_code FROM majors ORDER BY major_name;
templates.LIST_BY_CATEGORY: SELECT major_name, major_code, category FROM majors WHERE category = '{category}' ORDER BY major_name;
templates.GENERAL: SELECT DISTINCT major_name, major_code FROM majors ORDER BY major_name;

GET_ALL_MAJORS.default_template: SELECT DISTINCT major_name, major_code FROM majors ORDER BY major_name;

AVAILABLE_MAJORS.description: Get majors available at specific colleges

templates.BY_COLLEGE_NAME: SELECT DISTINCT m.major_name, m.major_code, s.school_name FROM majors m JOIN schools s ON m.school_id = s.school_id WHERE s.school_name ILIKE '%{to_collage}%' ORDER BY m.major_name;
templates.BY_COLLEGE_TYPE: SELECT DISTINCT m.major_name, m.major_code, s.school_name FROM majors m JOIN schools s ON m.school_id = s.school_id WHERE s.school_type = '{college_type}' ORDER BY s.school_name, m.major_name;
templates.BY_LOCATION: SELECT DISTINCT m.major_name, m.major_code, s.school_name FROM majors m JOIN schools s ON m.school_id = s.school_id WHERE s.location ILIKE '%{location}%' ORDER BY s.school_name, m.major_name;
templates.GENERAL: SELECT DISTINCT m.major_name, m.major_code, s.school_name FROM majors m JOIN schools s ON m.school_id = s.school_id WHERE s.school_name ILIKE '%{to_collage}%' ORDER BY m.major_name;

AVAILABLE_MAJORS.default_template: SELECT DISTINCT m.major_name, m.major_code, s.school_name FROM majors m JOIN schools s ON m.school_id = s.school_id WHERE s.school_name ILIKE '%{to_collage}%' ORDER BY m.major_name;

templates.BY_MAJOR: SELECT r.requirement_type, c.course_code, c.course_title, c.units, r.is_required FROM requirements r JOIN courses c ON r.course_id = c.course_id JOIN majors m ON r.major_id = m.major_id JOIN schools s ON m.school_id = s.school_id WHERE m.major_name ILIKE '%{major}%' AND s.school_name ILIKE '%{to_collage}%' ORDER BY r.requirement_type, c.course_code;
templates.BY_PROGRAM: SELECT r.requirement_type, c.course_code, c.course_title, c.units FROM requirements r JOIN courses c ON r.course_id = c.course_id JOIN majors m ON r.major_id = m.major_id WHERE m.major_name ILIKE '%{major}%' ORDER BY r.requirement_type, c.course_code;
templates.BY_TRANSFER_PATH: SELECT r.requirement_type, c.course_code, c.course_title, a.from_course_code, a.from_course_title FROM requirements r JOIN courses c ON r.course_id = c.course_id JOIN articulations a ON c.course_id = a.to_course_id JOIN majors m ON r.major_id = m.major_id WHERE m.major_name ILIKE '%{major}%' ORDER BY r.requirement_type;
templates.GENERAL: SELECT r.requirement_type, c.course_code, c.course_title, c.units FROM requirements r JOIN courses c ON r.course_id = c.course_id JOIN majors m ON r.major_id = m.major_id JOIN schools s ON m.school_id = s.school_id WHERE m.major_name ILIKE '%{major}%' AND s.school_name ILIKE '%{to_collage}%' ORDER BY r.requirement_type, c.course_code;

COURSE_REQUIREMENTS.default_template: SELECT r.requirement_type, c.course_code, c.course_title, c.units FROM requirements r JOIN courses c ON r.course_id = c.course_id JOIN majors m ON r.major_id = m.major_id JOIN schools s ON m.school_id = s.school_id WHERE m.major_name ILIKE '%{major}%' AND s.school_name ILIKE '%{to_collage}%' ORDER BY r.requirement_type, c.course_code;

templates.SPECIFIC_COURSE: SELECT a.from_course_code, a.from_course_title, a.to_course_code, a.to_course_title, s_from.school_name as from_school, s_to.school_name as to_school FROM articulations a JOIN schools s_from ON a.from_school_id = s_from.school_id JOIN schools s_to ON a.to_school_id = s_to.school_id WHERE s_from.school_name ILIKE '%{from_collage}%' AND s_to.school_name ILIKE '%{to_collage}%';
templates.FROM_TO_COLLEGES: SELECT a.from_course_code, a.from_course_title, a.to_course_code, a.to_course_title FROM articulations a JOIN schools s_from ON a.from_school_id = s_from.school_id JOIN schools s_to ON a.to_school_id = s_to.school_id WHERE s_from.school_name ILIKE '%{from_collage}%' AND s_to.school_name ILIKE '%{to_collage}%' ORDER BY a.from_course_code;
templates.BY_MAJOR: SELECT a.from_course_code, a.from_course_title, a.to_course_code, a.to_course_title, r.requirement_type FROM articulations a JOIN requirements r ON a.to_course_id = r.course_id JOIN majors m ON r.major_id = m.major_id JOIN schools s_from ON a.from_school_id = s_from.school_id JOIN schools s_to ON a.to_school_id = s_to.school_id WHERE s_from.school_name ILIKE '%{from_collage}%' AND s_to.school_name ILIKE '%{to_collage}%' AND m.major_name ILIKE '%{major}%' ORDER BY r.requirement_type, a.from_course_code;
templates.GENERAL_TRANSFER: SELECT a.from_course_code, a.from_course_title, a.to_course_code, a.to_course_title FROM articulations a JOIN schools s_from ON a.from_school_id = s_from.school_id JOIN schools s_to ON a.to_school_id = s_to.school_id WHERE s_from.school_name ILIKE '%{from_collage}%' AND s_to.school_name ILIKE '%{to_collage}%';
templates.GENERAL: SELECT a.from_course_code, a.from_course_title, a.to_course_code, a.to_course_title FROM articulations a JOIN schools s_from ON a.from_school_id = s_from.school_id JOIN schools s_to ON a.to_school_id = s_to.school_id WHERE s_from.school_name ILIKE '%{from_collage}%' AND s_to.school_name ILIKE '%{to_collage}%' ORDER BY a.from_course_code;
